def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

import json,os
G=load()
di,do=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
def analyze(g):
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    return c
print(analyze(di))
# object: rare non-bg colors; find object cells
def solve(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # object colors: cells forming the contiguous small object; noise = other rare color
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    obj=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=bg]
    # separate object (contiguous) from noise: find largest contiguous group
    seen=set(); groups=[]
    cells={(i,j) for i,j,_ in obj}
    for c0 in cells:
        if c0 in seen: continue
        stack=[c0]; grp=[]
        while stack:
            x=stack.pop()
            if x in seen: continue
            seen.add(x); grp.append(x)
            i,j=x
            for di_,dj_ in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                if (i+di_,j+dj_) in cells: stack.append((i+di_,j+dj_))
        groups.append(grp)
    groups.sort(key=len)
    objgrp=groups[-1]; noisegrp=groups[0]
    noise_col=g[noisegrp[0][0]][noisegrp[0][1]]
    # object shape as (dr,dc,color) relative to middle cell of object
    rs=[i for i,j in objgrp]; cs=[j for i,j in objgrp]
    # orientation: vertical if height>1 else horizontal
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
    shape=[(i-r0,j-c0,g[i][j]) for i,j in objgrp]
    mid=(max(s[0] for s in shape))//2 if any(s[0] for s in shape) else (max(s[1] for s in shape))//2
    vertical = any(s[0] for s in shape)
    anchor = mid  # middle offset along the line
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for cell in noisegrp:
        i,j=cell
        if vertical:
            for dr,dc,col in shape:
                ri,rj=i+dr-anchor, j+dc
                if 0<=ri<H and 0<=rj<W: out[ri][rj]=col
        else:
            for dr,dc,col in shape:
                ri,rj=i, j+dc-anchor
                if 0<=ri<H and 0<=rj<W: out[ri][rj]=col
    return out
r=solve(di)
print(r==do)
for a,b in zip(r,do):
    if a!=b: print(a,b)
# test
